ITA-2.8.12 brahmakāyaḥ ब्रह्मकायः
Person with pure, truthful temperament
The characteristics of the person with a pure, truthful temperament are purity, devoutness, knowledge seeking, respectful of elders, a good host and an ardent performer of rituals. The basic tendencies of the mind, intellect and behaviour are a result of the dominance of the three primordial psychophysical attributes of nature: tranquillity, harmony (satva), agitation, activity (rajas) and inertia (tamas). Although difficult, it is possible that the specific mental and physical personality type may be influenced and refined by education and the inculcation of spiritual values.

ITA-10.2.12 brahmacaryam ब्रह्मचर्यम्
Celibacy
Non-indulgence in sensual pleasures including sexual activity.
